subject: Next steps: Private VPC architecture review for FinCloud
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@fincloud.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@fincloud.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Private VPC architecture review for FinCloud

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned: 

- Goal: Walk through a Private VPC/on-prem architecture for your PoC — networking, auth/KMS, data flow, and operational handoffs.
- Outcome we want: agreement on topology, list of infra constraints (IP ranges, proxy/load balancer requirements), and a mutual action plan for a pilot.

To make the deep-dive most useful, we'd like to schedule a 45–60 minute architecture review with our Solutions/Infra engineer (Dev Patel) and Rishi from Sales Ops. 

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed 28 Apr — 9:00–10:00 AM PT
- Thu 29 Apr — 11:00–12:00 PM PT

If those don't work, please share 2–3 times that do. I've attached a short pre-call checklist that will speed things up (networking info, tentative CIDR ranges, any compliance or audit people to include).

Attaching: [Attachment: fincloud_precall_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0133
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 08:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Private VPC architecture review for FinCloud

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick recap and the checklist. FinCloud is definitely interested in a Private VPC deployment for the pilot; the main things we'd like to cover in the review are: 

- Networking (cross-account peering, NAT/GW options)
- KMS integration and key management flow
- Data residency and audit/logging requirements
- Expected footprint (GPU/instance sizing) for initial pilot

Of the proposed slots, Wed 28 Apr 9:00 AM PT should work for me. Priya will join as well. Could you add any SRE or infra folks on your side who'll own the network/ops discussion?

Thanks,
Sam Turner
Director, Platform Engineering
FinCloud

4) 5–10 min action items and next steps
